Rashi on Berakhot 55a:11:1.hebrew: ראה קראתי בשם - ראה משמע: היש בלבך? תן עיניך בדבר:
Rashi on Berakhot 55a:11:1.english: See, I have called by name - "See" implies: Is it [acceptable] in your heart? Set your eyes on the matter.

Rashi on Berakhot 55a:12:1.hebrew: לך אמור לו לבצלאל עשה משכן ארון וכלים - שכן הם סדורים בפרשת כי תשא: ראה קראתי בשם וגו', את אהל מועד ואת הארון לעדות, וכל הפרשה. ומשה אמר לו: עשה ארון וכלים, כגון שלחן ומנורה, ואחר כך משכן — דס"ל לר"י שכסדר שהם סדורים בויקחו לי תרומה אמר לו:
Rashi on Berakhot 55a:12:1.english: Go say to Bezalel: Make a tabernacle, an ark, and vessels - For so they are ordered in Parashat Ki Tisa: "See, I have called by name..." etc., "the Tent of Meeting, and the Ark of Testimony...", and the entire passage. And Moses said to him, "Make an ark and vessels" — such as the table and the menorah — "and afterward a tabernacle," for Rabbi Yonatan holds that he spoke to him according to the order in which they are arranged in [the portion of] "They shall take for Me an offering" [Parashat Terumah].

Rashi on Berakhot 55a:13:1.hebrew: אותיות שנבראו בהן שמים וארץ - על ידי צירופן, ובספר יצירה תני להו:
Rashi on Berakhot 55a:13:1.english: Letters with which heaven and earth were created - [They were created] through their combination, and in Sefer Yetzirah they are taught.

Rashi on Berakhot 55a:15:1.hebrew: כל חלום ולא טוות - כל חלומות יראה אדם, ולא יראה אחד מאותן שהוא שרוי בתענית, שאינו טוב. טוות — לשון תענית, כמו ובת טוות האמור בדריוש (דניאל ו׳:י״ט):
Rashi on Berakhot 55a:15:1.english: Any dream, and not a fast - A person may see all [kinds of] dreams, but let him not see one of those [dreams while] he is in a state of fasting, for it is not good. Tvat [is] an expression of fasting, like "and he spent the night fasting" [uvat tevat], stated concerning Darius (Daniel 6:19).

Rashi on Berakhot 55a:15:2.english: That is not interpreted - That they did not interpret it.

Rashi on Berakhot 55a:15:3.hebrew: כאגרתא דלא מקריא - לא טוב ולא רע הוא, שכל החלומות הולכין אחר הפתרון:
Rashi on Berakhot 55a:15:3.english: Like an unread letter - It is neither good nor bad, for all dreams follow the interpretation.

Rashi on Berakhot 55a:15:4.english: Preferable to a good dream - For it brings a person to repentance.

Rashi on Berakhot 55a:15:5.hebrew: עציבותיה מסתייה - דיו עצבונו — מה שאדם מתעצב עליו מבטל את החלום:
Rashi on Berakhot 55a:15:5.english: His sadness is enough for him - His sadness suffices for him — [the fact] that a person is saddened over it nullifies the dream.

Rashi on Berakhot 55a:15:6.english: Even for me - For I am blind [lit., enlightened of eyes].

Rashi on Berakhot 55a:15:7.english: His merriment sobers him up - Nullifies it for him.

Rashi on Berakhot 55a:15:8.hebrew: מנגדא - ממלקות. קשה לגוף האדם יותר ממלקות, לפי שדואג ממנו:
Rashi on Berakhot 55a:15:8.english: Than lashes - [Meaning,] than lashes. It is harder on a person's body than lashes, because he worries about it.

Rashi on Berakhot 55a:15:9.english: This is a bad dream - Out of fear of it, he will repent and humble himself.

Rashi on Berakhot 55a:1:1.hebrew: מעיין בה - אומר בלבו שתיעשה בקשתו, לפי שהתפלל בכונה:
Rashi on Berakhot 55a:1:1.english: Expects it - He says in his heart that his request will be fulfilled, because he prayed with devotion.

Rashi on Berakhot 55a:1:2.english: Heartache - For his request is not fulfilled.

Rashi on Berakhot 55a:1:3.hebrew: תוחלת - לשון תפלה, כמו ויחל משה (שמות לב):
Rashi on Berakhot 55a:1:3.english: Hope - [This is] an expression of prayer, as in: "And Moses beseeched" (Exodus 32).

Rashi on Berakhot 55a:1:4.hebrew: מזכירין עונותיו - שעל ידיהן מפשפשים למעלה במעשיו, לומר: בוטח זה בזכיותיו, נראה מה הם:
Rashi on Berakhot 55a:1:4.english: [They] evoke his sins - For through them, they scrutinize his deeds Above, saying: "This one relies on his merits; let us see what they are."

Rashi on Berakhot 55a:1:5.english: An inclined wall - A place of danger.

Rashi on Berakhot 55a:1:6.hebrew: מוסר דין - בוטח הוא בזכיותיו שחברו יהיה נענש על ידו:
Rashi on Berakhot 55a:1:6.english: Invoking divine judgment - He is confident in his merits that his fellow will be punished on his account.

Rashi on Berakhot 55a:2:1.hebrew: ה"ג: הא דמעיין, הא דלא מעיין:
Rashi on Berakhot 55a:2:1.english: This is the correct reading: This [is one who] expects [it]; this [is one who] does not expect [it].

Rashi on Berakhot 55a:4:1.english: Tendrils of grapevines - Vedilles, in Old French.

Rashi on Berakhot 55a:4:2.hebrew: מוריגי בהמה - כל בשר שבבהמה שאינו חלק, אלא דומה למורג חרוץ שאינו חלק — כמו החיך, והלשון, והכרס הפנימי, ובית הכוסות:
Rashi on Berakhot 55a:4:2.english: Threshing sledges of an animal - Any meat of an animal that is not smooth, but rather resembles a sharp threshing sledge, which is not smooth — such as the palate, the tongue, the inner rumen, and the reticulum.

Rashi on Berakhot 55a:4:3.hebrew: התולה - שאינו יושב אלא על ברכיו, שמתוך כך נקביו נפתחין יותר מדאי:
Rashi on Berakhot 55a:4:3.english: One who suspends [himself] - That he does not sit [down], but rather [rests] on his knees, for because of this his orifices open up excessively.

Rashi on Berakhot 55a:5:1.hebrew: הכי גרסינן: הא דמאריך ותלי, הא דמאריך ולא תלי:
Rashi on Berakhot 55a:5:1.english: This is the correct reading: This [is one who] prolongs and suspends [himself]; this [is one who] prolongs and does not suspend [himself].

Rashi on Berakhot 55a:6:1.hebrew: למגדלי חזירים ומלוי ברבית - שכרן מרובה בלא טורח, ושמחים בחלקם, לכך פניהם צהובים:
Rashi on Berakhot 55a:6:1.english: To pig breeders and usurers - Their profit is plentiful without toil, and they rejoice in their portion; therefore, their faces are radiant.

Rashi on Berakhot 55a:6:2.hebrew: הימנותא - לשון שבועה, כלומר: באמונה, שתיהן אסורות לי:
Rashi on Berakhot 55a:6:2.english: By faith - An expression of an oath, that is to say: "By faith, both of them are forbidden to me."

Rashi on Berakhot 55a:8:1.hebrew: ואברכה מברכיך - והמברך ברכת המזון מברך לבעל הבית:
Rashi on Berakhot 55a:8:1.english: And I will bless those who bless you - And the one who recites Grace after Meals blesses the host.

Rashi on Berakhot 55a:8:2.hebrew: יוסף מת קודם לאחיו - דכתיב: וימת יוסף וכל אחיו (שמות א׳:ו׳):
Rashi on Berakhot 55a:8:2.english: Joseph died before his brothers - As it is written: "And Joseph died, and all his brothers" (Exodus 1:6).

Rashi on Berakhot 55a:9:1.hebrew: צריכים רחמים - צריכים לבקש רחמים שיבאו, לפי שהם בידו של הקב"ה, ואין להם רשות לבא אלא ברשותו:
Rashi on Berakhot 55a:9:1.english: Require mercy - [One] needs to plead for mercy that they should come, because they are in the hand of the Holy One, Blessed be He, and they have no permission to come except with His permission.

Tosafot on Berakhot 55a:12:1.hebrew: לך אמור לבצלאל עשה משכן ארון וכלים - ואם תאמר: היכא אשכחן שצוה הקדוש ברוך הוא לעשות משכן תחלה, הרי בפרשת תרומה כתיב ארון תחלה? ויש לומר, דבפרשת כי תשא כתיב: "את אהל מועד ואת הארון לעדות":
Tosafot on Berakhot 55a:12:1.english: "Go say to Bezalel: Make a tabernacle, an ark, and vessels" - And if you say: Where do we find that the Holy One, Blessed be He, commanded to make the tabernacle first, for behold, in Parashat Terumah the ark is written first? And one can say that in Parashat Ki Tisa it is written: "The Tent of Meeting and the Ark for the Testimony."
